verdict.rationale: Synctera provides a documented, extensive public REST API (confirmed by live OpenAPI spec and llms.txt with 664+ pages of v2 docs) covering customer onboarding, accounts, cards, transfers, ACH, wires, KYC/KYB, webhooks, and sandbox testing with API keys — enabling an AI-native user to drive the full platform programmatically. Missing for 10: independent/third-party corroboration of real-world API usage (e.g., community integration reports) and explicit mention of SDKs or agent-specific tooling beyond raw REST/OpenAPI.
